# Acknowledgments

## Developed by

[Kittinat Gerdsri](https://kittinatger.github.io/kittinat-gerdsri/)

## Tech stack

- [Next.js](https://nextjs.org) (App Router) + TypeScript
- [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com) v4
- [`@vercel/postgres`](https://vercel.com/docs/storage/vercel-postgres) for storage
- [`@google/genai`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@google/genai) for receipt vision extraction (Gemini)
- [Frankfurter](https://frankfurter.app) for free, ECB-rate currency conversion
- [Resend](https://resend.com) for sending password reset and notification emails

## Icons

Tally's interface icons — navigation, actions, Settings rows, Analytics
sections and category icons — are from [Phosphor Icons](https://phosphoricons.com/)
(mostly the "fill" weight, matching the author's portfolio site), used via
[`@phosphor-icons/react`](https://github.com/phosphor-icons/react) under the
MIT License, Copyright (c) 2020-2024 Phosphor Icons.

Map-app logos in Settings > Maps app (Apple, Google Maps, Waze, Baidu, Naver,
Kakao, HERE, Organic Maps, OpenStreetMap) are from [Simple Icons](https://simpleicons.org/)
(CC0). Those logos remain trademarks of their respective owners and are used
only to identify each app; providers not in Simple Icons get a generic pin icon.

The handful of remaining graphics that aren't icon-pack glyphs (charts, the
payment-card chip and contactless marks, the app's own tally-mark logo) are
drawn in-house.
